ev.q: World of Tanks is a tactical action game
Lots and lots of PVP fun
Its armored vehicles are fast enough to draw you into the action
Adjust their performance to better suit your unique playstyle
You have to play over and over and over (grinding)
I beat myself up playing more than 6000 games
playing World of Tanks for 15 years
Great game to play with friends, comrades and brothers in arms
Nothing builds character like spending 5 minutes hiding behind a rock just to explode instantly
Easy to learn, hard to master
